name: Cleric
description: A devoted healer who channels divine light to mend wounds and shield allies from harm.
lore: Servants of the Dawn Temple, Clerics channel holy energy to sustain their companions through the darkest dungeons. Their presence is the difference between a triumphant return and a total party wipe.

abilities.name: Smite
abilities.description: Strikes with holy energy. Weak but deals +50% to undead and demons.

abilities.name: Heal
abilities.description: Restores HP to a single ally. Scales with Healing Power.

abilities.name: Purify
abilities.description: Removes all debuffs from an ally and heals for a small amount.

abilities.name: Divine Shield
abilities.description: Places a holy barrier on an ally that absorbs damage. Scales with Healing Power.

abilities.name: Prayer of Healing
abilities.description: A prayer that restores HP to all party members.

abilities.name: Holy Aura
abilities.description: Passive: All allies regen 5 HP/turn and gain +10% Dark and Holy Resistance.

abilities.name: Divine Intervention
abilities.description: Ultimate: Heals all allies 50% max HP, cleanses debuffs, revives fallen at 25% HP, and grants 1 turn immunity.

synergies: Warrior: Healing + shields on the Warrior is the core tanking strategy
Paladin: Double healer comp provides extreme sustain for long boss fights
Mage: Divine Shield lets the Mage cast without interruption
weaknesses: Low STR means near-zero physical attack and defense contribution
hire_description: A serene figure in white robes tends to a wounded adventurer near the guild entrance. She looks up with calm eyes. "The Dawn Temple teaches that all who venture into darkness deserve a light at their side."
